description: Maisons du vélo Île-de-France Mobilités et Points de location Véligo Location is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités, Cyclonova. Une Maison du Vélo est un local physique qui assure une forte visibilité et un accès simplifié à une large gamme de services vélos. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Services vélo, Conseils, Location, Réparation, Vélo, Circulation douce. The portal shows 246 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
